actor.description:

* `0` - user generated (message was generated directly by a user's
  actions; their userid is recorded on the message object)

  auto-approved or expired a request)

* `3` - all recipients (all recipients declined the request)

replaced by either request_id or swap_id.

required.

end_time.description: Full datetime the request ends at.

hours.description: The number of hours of paid time off to use.

paid.description: If the timeoff request is for paid timeoff

start_time.description: Full datetime the request starts at.

The current status of the request. The field user_status is more
granular (it supports the Denied status) and should be used instead of
status..
  * `0` = Pending
  * `1` = Canceled
  * `2` = Accepted
  * `3` = Expired
